body:
WHAT
The version tool (tools/version, a zero-dependency Node script that computes releases from git history) writes CHANGELOG.md. renderRelease turns a release plan into one markdown section: heading '## <version> — <date>', an optional 'Breaking changes' list with the BREAKING CHANGE notes, then one '### <section>' block per configured commit type in configuration order, each commit as a bullet with optional scope and commit link, and a compare link. prependRelease inserts that section at the top of CHANGELOG.md under a '<!-- new-release -->' marker, creating the file with a fixed header when absent.

WHY
A hand-edited changelog drifts from the commits actually released and from the version tags; insertion that rewrote earlier entries would corrupt the release history.

WHERE
tools/version/lib/changelog.mjs — constants HEADER and MARKER, renderRelease(plan, config, {date, repositoryUrl}), bullet(commit, repositoryUrl), breakingNotes(body), prependRelease(root, release); consumed by tools/version/bin/magentra-version.mjs commandApply/reportPlan.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. renderRelease with a plan holding one feat, one fix and one docs commit and the repo's version.config.json types emits '### Features', '### Bug fixes', '### Documentation' in that configuration order, skips sections with no commits, and each bullet reads '- **scope:** subject ([shortHash](<url>/commit/<hash>))' when repositoryUrl is given and '- subject' with no link when it is null.
2. A commit with breaking:true and body 'BREAKING CHANGE: remove X\nuse Y instead' produces a '### Breaking changes' block whose bullet is followed by an indented note 'remove X use Y instead' (continuation lines joined), and a plan with fromTag 'v1.0.0' and repositoryUrl adds '[Compare with v1.0.0](<url>/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0)'.
3. A plan with isFirstRelease:true renders 'The first release.' under the heading and no compare link even when repositoryUrl is set.
4. prependRelease in a temp dir with no CHANGELOG.md writes HEADER + MARKER + two newlines + release; calling it again with a second release yields a file where the second section appears directly after the marker and the first section's text is unchanged byte-for-byte below it.
5. prependRelease on a hand-written CHANGELOG.md without the marker inserts the release just before the first '\n## ' heading, leaving the intro and all existing sections intact; on a file with no '## ' at all it appends after the trimmed content.
